cost: Splits/groups O(1). Lessons O(bytes+courses log courses+files log files) and output map inserts; treebank O(bytes+Nlog books+Nlog output); pool O(bytes+Nlog N) map construction. External reads/lesson workflows not executed.
description: Kind selects Bible split by book, Docs split by document modulo10, TrainOnly always train. Bible discourse=(book,0), others=(group,document). Docs sampling keeps floor(document/10)%n==0; other kinds always sampled. Lessons sort courses/files and extract register-specific lines, treebank_texts associates preceding #text with encountered #sent_id, pool_texts enumerates tab-bearing lines into groups1000.

inverse: TrainOnly cannot select held-out split and Bible cannot be excluded by sampled even n0. Docs sample0 is outside domain and can panic. Nonmatching register lines never enter output map.

A split label admits modulo residue classes; group cannot recover verse/unit coordinate. Pool output loses original ids and rejected lines. Treebank output can reflect empty text when sent_id precedes text, so it does not invert conventional CoNLL ordering generally.
limitations: Source-derived effectful CLI/corpus paths only; no live model/annotator/training/filesystem/site run.
Finite synthetic helper checks and partial syntax; no universal proof or executable percent surrogate.
